passage.label: Al-Baqarah — turning away after covenant; sabbath transgressors turned to apes; cow command narrative with detailed questioning; striking slain man with part of cow; Allah brings dead to life

arabicExcerpts.text: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّيۡتُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَۖ فَلَوۡلَا فَضۡلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَرَحۡمَتُهُۥ لَكُنتُم مِّنَ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ
وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعۡتَدَوۡاْ مِنكُمۡ فِي ٱلسَّبۡتِ فَقُلۡنَا لَهُمۡ كُونُواْ قِرَدَةً خَٰسِـِٔينَ
فَجَعَلۡنَٰهَا نَكَٰلٗا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهَا وَمَا خَلۡفَهَا وَمَوۡعِظَةٗ لِّلۡمُتَّقِينَ
وَإِذۡ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأۡمُرُكُمۡ أَن تَذۡبَحُواْ بَقَرَةٗۖ قَالُوٓاْ أَتَتَّخِذُنَا هُزُوٗاۖ قَالَ أَعُوذُ بِٱللَّهِ أَنۡ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡجَٰهِلِينَ
قَالُواْ ٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا هِيَۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٞ لَّا فَارِضٞ وَلَا بِكۡرٌ عَوَانُۢ بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَۖ فَٱفۡعَلُواْ مَا تُؤۡمَرُونَ
قَالُواْ ٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا لَوۡنُهَاۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٞ صَفۡرَآءُ فَاقِعٞ لَّوۡنُهَا تَسُرُّ ٱلنَّـٰظِرِينَ
قَالُواْ ٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا هِيَ إِنَّ ٱلۡبَقَرَ تَشَٰبَهَ عَلَيۡنَا وَإِنَّآ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَمُهۡتَدُونَ

قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٞ لَّا ذَلُولٞ تُثِيرُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَلَا تَسۡقِي ٱلۡحَرۡثَ مُسَلَّمَةٞ لَّا شِيَةَ فِيهَاۚ قَالُواْ ٱلۡـَٰٔنَ جِئۡتَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ فَذَبَحُوهَا وَمَا كَادُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ

mainSubject.label: Consequences of turning away after covenant; sabbath violators transformed into despised apes as deterrent and lesson; Allah's command through Musa to slaughter a cow; Bani Israel's excessive questioning about cow's attributes; final compliance after clarification; striking slain man with part of cow demonstrating Allah's power to revive the dead

subordinateSubjects.label: Turning away after covenant: without Allah's favor and mercy they would be losers
Sabbath transgressors commanded to be despised apes
Transformation made as deterrent punishment for contemporaries and successors
Musa conveying Allah's command to slaughter a cow
Bani Israel accusing Musa of ridicule
Musa seeking refuge in Allah from being among the ignorant
First clarification request: what kind of cow? Answer: neither old nor virgin, median
Second clarification: color? Answer: yellow, bright, pleasing to observers
Third clarification: cows look alike; if Allah wills we will be guided
Final specification: untrained, no fault, no spot; they finally complied but barely

propheticNarratives.label: Musa conveying the cow command and responding to Bani Israel's questions

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Reluctant obedience: complying with divine command only after exhaustive questioning
Accusing prophets of mockery when receiving difficult commands

relationships.label: Prophet-community dynamic: messenger conveys, people resist through excessive questioning

notes: Pass A pilot 5, passage 12/4. The cow narrative gives Surah Al-Baqarah its name. Contains sabbath ape-transformation as nakal. Excessive questioning pattern unique to this passage.
